words.enDefinition: using reported financial information to interpret performance and position

examples.en: The course used financial statement analysis to compare two fictional retailers with very different business models.
examples.zh: 课程用「财务报表分析」比较了两家商业模式很不同的虚构零售商。

examples.en: Our financial statement analysis helped explain why profit rose while cash collections changed very little.
examples.zh: 我们的「财务报表分析」解释了为什么利润上升而收款变化很小。

words.enDefinition: statements showing amounts for more than one reporting period

examples.en: The comparative financial statements placed the two years side by side for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 这道课堂练习中的「比较财务报表」把两年的数据并排列出。

examples.en: We found the missing prior-year figure in the comparative financial statements supplied with the case.
examples.zh: 我们在案例所附的「比较财务报表」中找到了缺失的上年数字。

words.enDefinition: an earlier period used as the reference for current figures

examples.en: The comparative period ended in March, so our exercise used the same months this year.
examples.zh: 「比较期间」截至三月，因此练习选用了本年相同的月份。

examples.en: Our group checked the length of the comparative period before explaining the reported revenue change.
examples.zh: 在解释报告所列的收入变动前，小组核对了「比较期间」有多长。

words.enDefinition: prior-period amounts presented again after a correction or other restatement

examples.en: The worksheet showed restated comparatives after the fictional company corrected a prior-year reporting error.
examples.zh: 虚构公司更正上期报告错误后，练习表列出了「重述后比较数据」。

examples.en: We used the restated comparatives for the trend chart and kept the original version for reference.
examples.zh: 我们的趋势图采用「重述后比较数据」，原始版本则保留以供查阅。

words.enDefinition: prior-period amounts regrouped to match a different presentation

examples.en: The reclassified comparatives moved delivery charges into a separate row without changing the total.
examples.zh: 「重新分类的比较数据」把配送费移到单独一行，总额保持不变。

examples.en: We checked whether last year's sales appeared in the reclassified comparatives under the same segment headings.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「重新分类的比较数据」是否在同样的分部标题下列示去年销售额。

words.enDefinition: the reference period against which other periods are compared

examples.en: We chose 2022 as the base period because the sample had a complete year of data.
examples.zh: 我们选二〇二二年为「基期」，因为样本有该年的完整数据。

examples.en: Changing the base period altered the index values on the chart without changing the original amounts.
examples.zh: 更换「基期」改变了图上的指数值，原来的金额保持不变。

words.enDefinition: an index that sets a reference year's value to 100

examples.en: The base-year index let us plot sales and staffing costs on the same chart.
examples.zh: 「基年指数」让我们能把销售额和人工成本放在同一张图里。

examples.en: We calculated the base-year index after choosing a year with complete figures for every business unit.
examples.zh: 我们选了一年各业务单位数据都齐全的年份，再计算「基年指数」。

collocations: compare figures using a base-year index

words.enDefinition: examining figures over time to identify a pattern

examples.en: Our trend analysis showed that product returns increased each year even though sales grew only slightly.
examples.zh: 我们的「趋势分析」显示，退货逐年增加，而销售额只略有增长。

examples.en: The tutor asked how a three-year trend analysis might hide an unusual quarter within the period.
examples.zh: 导师问，「趋势分析」跨越三年时，可能怎样掩盖其中一个异常季度。

words.enDefinition: comparing the amounts in individual statement rows across periods

examples.en: The horizontal analysis showed how much selling expenses changed from one year to the next.
examples.zh: 「横向分析」说明了销售费用在两个相邻年度之间变动了多少。

examples.en: We used horizontal analysis to compare the same income statement rows across three classroom cases.
examples.zh: 我们用「横向分析」比较了三个课堂案例中利润表相同项目的跨期变化。

collocations: horizontal analysis of the income statement

words.enDefinition: expressing statement items relative to a common amount within that statement

examples.en: The class used vertical analysis to express each expense as a percentage of total revenue.
examples.zh: 同学们用「纵向分析」把每项费用表示为其占总收入的比例。

examples.en: Our vertical analysis expressed each asset category as a share of the firm's total assets.
examples.zh: 我们的「纵向分析」把各类资产表示为其占公司总资产的比例。

collocations: vertical analysis of a balance sheet

words.enDefinition: an income statement showing items as percentages of revenue

examples.en: The common-size income statement showed that rent took a larger share of sales this year.
examples.zh: 「共同比利润表」显示，本年租金占销售额的比例提高了。

examples.en: The tutor used a common-size income statement to compare two fictional stores of very different sizes.
examples.zh: 导师用「共同比利润表」比较了两家规模差异很大的虚构商店。

collocations: a column on the common-size income statement

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet showing items as percentages of total assets

examples.en: We prepared a common-size balance sheet to compare asset composition at the two sample companies.
examples.zh: 我们编制了「共同比资产负债表」，用来比较两家样本公司的资产构成。

examples.en: The common-size balance sheet showed that inventory made up more of total assets than before.
examples.zh: 「共同比资产负债表」显示，存货占总资产的比例比以前高。

collocations: figures on a common-size balance sheet

words.enDefinition: a difference stated in the original units between two values

examples.en: The worksheet listed absolute change in pounds before calculating the percentage movement in sales.
examples.zh: 练习表先用英镑列出「变动额」，再算销售额变动的百分比。

examples.en: We compared the absolute change in expenses for both stores before discussing their different sizes.
examples.zh: 我们先比较了两家商店费用的「变动额」，然后讨论规模差异。

collocations: the absolute change in operating costs

words.enDefinition: the change relative to the starting amount, expressed as a percentage

examples.en: The percentage change was larger for the smaller store despite a similar rise measured in pounds.
examples.zh: 两家店按英镑计的增幅相近，但小店的「百分比变动」更大。

examples.en: The class calculated percentage change after checking which value belonged in the starting column.
examples.zh: 同学们先核对基准栏里该用哪个数，再算「百分比变动」。

words.enDefinition: growth compared with the corresponding period one year earlier

examples.en: The chart showed year-over-year growth by comparing this June with June of the previous year.
examples.zh: 图表通过比较今年六月与去年六月来显示「同比增长」。

examples.en: We checked whether the reported year-over-year growth covered the same number of trading weeks.
examples.zh: 我们核对了报告的「同比增长」是否取自营业周数相同的两段期间。

words.enDefinition: growth compared with the immediately preceding period

examples.en: The report showed sequential growth by comparing third-quarter sales with the figures for the second quarter.
examples.zh: 报告将第三季度销售额与第二季度数据比较，展示「环比增长」。

examples.en: We calculated sequential growth from one month to the next in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 在课堂练习中，我们计算了相邻两个月的「环比增长」。

collocations: sequential growth from the previous quarter

words.enDefinition: the difference between two values already expressed as percentages

examples.en: The exercise reported a percentage-point change when the margin rose from eight to ten percent.
examples.zh: 利润率从百分之八升至百分之十时，练习报告了「百分点变动」。

examples.en: Our chart showed the percentage-point change in each expense category's share of total revenue.
examples.zh: 图表显示各费用类别占总收入比例的「百分点变动」。

words.enDefinition: a difference expressed in hundredths of a percentage point

examples.en: The worksheet used a basis-point change to express a small increase in the operating margin.
examples.zh: 练习表用「基点变动」表示营业利润率的小幅上升。

examples.en: The recorded basis-point change was one hundred when the margins differed by one percentage point.
examples.zh: 两项利润率相差一个百分点，记录的「基点变动」为一百个基点。

words.enDefinition: the twelve-month period ending at the latest stated date

examples.en: The chart used the trailing twelve months to compare both stores through the latest reporting month.
examples.zh: 图表用「最近十二个月」的数据比较两家商店截至最近报告月份的表现。

examples.en: We checked which quarterly totals made up the trailing twelve months in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习中哪些季度总额合计构成「最近十二个月」的数据。

collocations: revenue for the trailing twelve months

words.enDefinition: an average recalculated as a fixed-length period moves forward

examples.en: The group used a rolling average to show whether reported monthly expenses were trending higher.
examples.zh: 小组用「滚动平均值」查看所报告的月度费用是否有上升趋势。

examples.en: We recalculated the rolling average every month after adding the latest value and dropping the oldest.
examples.zh: 我们每月加入最新数值、去掉最早数值，再重新计算「滚动平均值」。

collocations: a chart of the rolling average

words.enDefinition: to express shorter-period figures on an annual basis

examples.en: The worksheet asked us to annualise the figures before comparing amounts stated on different time bases.
examples.zh: 练习表要求我们先「将数字年化」，再比较按不同时间口径列示的金额。

examples.en: The tutor showed why we should state the assumptions whenever we annualise the figures.
examples.zh: 导师说明了每次「将数字年化」时为什么要交代所用假设。

collocations: annualise the figures using a stated assumption
annualise the figures from a short period

words.zhGloss: 按自然期间对齐的财务数据
words.enDefinition: financial amounts adjusted to cover common calendar dates so entities with different fiscal periods can be compared
acceptedZhAnswers: 按自然期间对齐的财务数据

examples.en: We used calendarised figures to compare two retailers whose financial years ended in different months.
examples.zh: 我们用「按自然期间对齐的财务数据」比较两家财年在不同月份结束的零售商。

examples.en: The worksheet presented calendarised figures after combining the relevant months from each company's annual and interim reports.
examples.zh: 练习表汇总了各公司年报和中报中相关月份的数据，列出「按自然期间对齐的财务数据」。

words.enDefinition: the influence of the comparison period's level on measured growth

examples.en: The tutor used a base effect to explain the large increase from an unusually weak prior-year quarter.
examples.zh: 导师用「基数效应」解释，为什么去年同期表现疲软时，本期的增长数字看起来很高。

examples.en: We identified a base effect because the earlier figures included several weeks with the store closed.
examples.zh: 此前的数据涵盖商店关门的几周，我们据此发现了「基数效应」。

words.enDefinition: sales measured across comparable operations under defined inclusion rules

examples.en: The report defined like-for-like sales using stores that were open in both periods under review.
examples.zh: 报告用两个比较期间都在营业的门店来界定「可比口径销售额」。

examples.en: Our group checked whether online orders were included in like-for-like sales for the sample retailer.
examples.zh: 小组核对了样本零售商的「可比口径销售额」是否包含网上订单。

words.enDefinition: revenue growth adjusted for acquisitions and other specified external effects

examples.en: The sample calculated organic revenue growth after excluding the contribution from a newly acquired business.
examples.zh: 样本剔除了新收购业务的贡献后，再计算「有机收入增长」。

examples.en: We read the note defining organic revenue growth to see which additional effects were excluded.
examples.zh: 我们阅读了定义「有机收入增长」的附注，查看还剔除了哪些影响。

collocations: the definition of organic revenue growth

words.enDefinition: growth measured using consistent exchange rates across periods

examples.en: The class compared constant-currency growth with the sales change measured at the actual exchange rates.
examples.zh: 同学们将「固定汇率口径增长」与按实际汇率衡量的销售额变动作了比较。

examples.en: We recalculated constant-currency growth using the exchange rates specified in the fictional report's footnote.
examples.zh: 我们用虚构报告脚注中列明的汇率重新计算「固定汇率口径增长」。

words.enDefinition: growth calculated from amounts as published in the reports

examples.en: The sample's reported growth included the sales of a business acquired during the year.
examples.zh: 样本的「报告口径增长」包含当年新收购业务带来的销售额。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why reported growth could differ from a constant-currency calculation for the period.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「报告口径增长」可能与该期间按固定汇率口径计算的增幅不同。

collocations: reconcile reported growth to an adjusted figure

words.enDefinition: the change in reported amounts attributable to newly acquired businesses

examples.en: The worksheet isolated the effect of acquisitions by identifying sales from the newly purchased subsidiary.
examples.zh: 练习表通过识别新收购子公司的销售额，单独分析了「收购影响」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which column showed the effect of acquisitions in the sample revenue bridge.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本收入桥接表的哪一栏列出了「收购影响」。

collocations: revenue including the effect of acquisitions

words.enDefinition: the part of a reported change caused by differences in exchange rates

examples.en: The revenue bridge included a foreign exchange effect for sales translated from another currency.
examples.zh: 收入桥接表列出了以另一种货币换算销售额时产生的「汇率变动影响」。

examples.en: We estimated the foreign exchange effect using the two exchange rates provided in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用练习提供的两个汇率估算了「汇率变动影响」。

words.enDefinition: separating changes attributable to prices, quantities, and the sales mix

examples.en: The class used price-volume-mix analysis to understand why revenue rose while total units sold barely changed.
examples.zh: 同学们用「价格销量组合分析」理解为什么总销量变化很小，收入却上升了。

examples.en: We used price-volume-mix analysis after noticing that the sample sold more of its higher-priced products.
examples.zh: 我们发现样本中单价较高的产品卖得更多，于是做了「价格销量组合分析」。

words.enDefinition: a breakdown connecting revenue levels through the factors that changed them

examples.en: The revenue bridge explained the increase from last year's figure to the current reported amount.
examples.zh: 「收入变动桥接表」解释了收入为何从上年数字增长到当前报告金额。

examples.en: Our worksheet used a revenue bridge to separate price increases and the contribution of a new branch.
examples.zh: 练习表用「收入变动桥接表」分别列出提价和新分店的贡献。

collocations: drivers shown in the revenue bridge

words.enDefinition: an increase in profit as a share of revenue

examples.en: The margin expansion came from lower material costs in the fictional manufacturer's main business.
examples.zh: 虚构制造商的主营业务材料成本降低，带来了「利润率上升」。

examples.en: Our group checked whether margin expansion meant the same thing as a rise in total profit.
examples.zh: 小组核对了「利润率上升」和利润总额增加是不是一回事。

words.enDefinition: a fall in profit as a share of revenue

examples.en: The case company reported margin contraction as labour costs rose faster than its sales.
examples.zh: 随着人工成本上涨得比销售额快，案例公司报告了「利润率下降」。

examples.en: We discussed how margin contraction could occur even when total sales increased during the quarter.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么季度总销售额增加时仍可能出现「利润率下降」。

words.enDefinition: the middle value of a measure for a comparison group

examples.en: The worksheet compared the retailer's operating margin with the peer median for the same period.
examples.zh: 练习表把零售商的营业利润率与同期「同行中位数」作了比较。

examples.en: We recalculated the peer median after removing a company with an unrelated business model.
examples.zh: 剔除一家商业模式不同的公司后，我们重新计算了「同行中位数」。

collocations: a figure below the peer median

words.enDefinition: using the same definitions or calculation methods throughout a comparison

examples.en: The sample table reported both years on a consistent basis after changing the expense categories.
examples.zh: 样本表在调整费用类别后，仍「按一致口径」报告两年的数据。

examples.en: Our group recalculated the figures on a consistent basis before comparing the two margins shown.
examples.zh: 小组先「按一致口径」重算数据，再比较表上的两个利润率。

collocations: report figures on a consistent basis
measure results on a consistent basis
compare years on a consistent basis

words.enDefinition: breaking a ratio into components to explain its movement

examples.en: The tutor used ratio decomposition to separate asset use from profitability in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 导师用「比率拆解」区分课堂案例中资产使用与盈利能力的影响。

examples.en: Our ratio decomposition showed which input explained most of the change in the reported measure.
examples.zh: 我们的「比率拆解」显示，哪个输入解释了报告指标变动的大部分。

words.enDefinition: a factor that explains a change or difference in profitability

examples.en: Lower delivery costs were the main profitability driver in the fictional retailer's second year.
examples.zh: 配送成本下降是虚构零售商第二年的主要「盈利驱动因素」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which profitability driver mattered most after removing the effect of currency changes.
examples.zh: 导师问，剔除汇率变动的影响后，哪个「盈利驱动因素」最重要。

words.enDefinition: analysis that breaks return on equity into component factors

examples.en: The class used DuPont analysis to explain how two companies achieved similar equity returns in different ways.
examples.zh: 同学们用「杜邦分析」解释了两家公司如何以不同方式取得相近的净资产收益率。

examples.en: Our tutor introduced DuPont analysis before asking which factor drove the increase in equity returns.
examples.zh: 导师介绍「杜邦分析」后，问是哪个因素推动了净资产收益率上升。

words.enDefinition: a decomposition of equity return into margin, asset turnover, and leverage

examples.en: In the three-step DuPont analysis, the worksheet multiplied net margin, asset turnover, and the equity multiplier.
examples.zh: 在「三因素杜邦分析」中，练习表将净利率、资产周转率与权益乘数相乘。

examples.en: The tutor asked which factor had changed most in the three-step DuPont analysis for the retailer.
examples.zh: 导师问，零售商的「三因素杜邦分析」中哪个因素变化最大。

collocations: factors in a three-step DuPont analysis

words.enDefinition: a decomposition of equity return into EBIT margin, interest burden, tax burden, asset turnover, and financial leverage

examples.en: Our five-step DuPont analysis separated the effect of interest from the effect of taxes.
examples.zh: 我们的「五因素杜邦分析」把利息影响和税收影响分开。

examples.en: The class expanded the model into a five-step DuPont analysis to explain both companies' results.
examples.zh: 同学们把模型扩展为「五因素杜邦分析」，解释两家公司的结果。

collocations: factors in a five-step DuPont analysis

words.enDefinition: revenue relative to the amount invested in fixed assets

examples.en: The sample factory's fixed asset turnover rose after sales increased without any new production equipment.
examples.zh: 样本工厂在没有新增生产设备的情况下提高了销售额，其「固定资产周转率」随之上升。

examples.en: We checked how the worksheet measured fixed assets before comparing the companies' fixed asset turnover.
examples.zh: 比较两家公司的「固定资产周转率」前，我们先确认练习表怎样计量固定资产。

collocations: a higher fixed asset turnover ratio

words.enDefinition: the average total asset balance used for a period

examples.en: The course exercise averaged the opening and closing balances to calculate average total assets.
examples.zh: 课程练习用期初和期末余额的平均数计算「平均总资产」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why average total assets could differ from the figure shown at year end.
examples.zh: 导师问，「平均总资产」为何可能与年末数字不同。

collocations: use average total assets as the denominator

words.enDefinition: the average shareholders' equity balance over the period analysed

examples.en: We used average shareholders' equity to account for the midyear change in the sample company's balance.
examples.zh: 样本公司的余额在年中发生变化，我们用「平均股东权益」来反映这一变化。

examples.en: The worksheet calculated average shareholders' equity from the beginning and ending amounts in the case.
examples.zh: 练习表用案例中的期初和期末金额计算「平均股东权益」。

collocations: a return on average shareholders' equity

words.enDefinition: operating assets less operating liabilities

examples.en: The exercise subtracted operating liabilities from operating assets to arrive at net operating assets.
examples.zh: 练习用经营资产减去经营负债，求出「净经营资产」。

examples.en: Our group checked which balances the fictional analyst treated as operating before calculating net operating assets.
examples.zh: 小组先确认虚构分析员把哪些余额视为经营性项目，再计算「净经营资产」。

collocations: a return on net operating assets

words.enDefinition: a measure of leverage calculated as assets divided by equity

examples.en: The equity multiplier increased when the case company added assets while equity remained unchanged.
examples.zh: 案例公司增加资产而权益不变时，「权益乘数」上升了。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which asset and equity balances the worksheet used to find the equity multiplier.
examples.zh: 导师问，练习表用了哪些资产和权益余额来计算「权益乘数」。

collocations: the equity multiplier in DuPont analysis

words.enDefinition: the influence of financing through debt on equity returns

examples.en: The case showed a financial leverage effect when equity returns changed more sharply than operating results.
examples.zh: 案例中净资产收益的变化比经营业绩更剧烈，体现了「财务杠杆效应」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained the financial leverage effect using two fictional stores with different financing arrangements.
examples.zh: 老师用融资安排不同的两家虚构商店解释「财务杠杆效应」。

words.enDefinition: pretax earnings divided by earnings before interest and taxes

examples.en: The worksheet used the interest burden factor to compare pretax profit with profit before interest and taxes.
examples.zh: 练习表用「利息负担因子」比较税前利润与息税前利润。

examples.en: In our simplified example, higher interest expense reduced the interest burden factor while operating profit stayed steady.
examples.zh: 在简化示例中，营业利润保持不变，但利息费用上升使「利息负担因子」下降。

collocations: use the interest burden factor in DuPont analysis

words.enDefinition: net income divided by pretax earnings in the DuPont breakdown

examples.en: The tax burden factor showed how much pretax income remained after tax in the classroom calculation.
examples.zh: 课堂计算用「税负因子」显示税前利润扣税后保留了多少。

examples.en: We calculated the tax burden factor before completing the five-part comparison in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先算了「税负因子」，再完成练习表里的五项比较。

words.enDefinition: operating profit expressed as a share of revenue

examples.en: The classroom calculation divided operating profit by revenue to find the operating margin.
examples.zh: 课堂用营业利润除以收入计算「营业利润率」。

examples.en: We compared operating margin under the same definitions before discussing the two stores' rent costs.
examples.zh: 我们先按相同定义比较「营业利润率」，再讨论两家商店的租金成本。

words.enDefinition: the percentage change in operating profit relative to the percentage change in sales

examples.en: The degree of operating leverage was higher for the fictional factory with larger fixed costs.
examples.zh: 在虚构案例中，固定成本较高的工厂有更高的「经营杠杆系数」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the degree of operating leverage could change at different sales levels.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么销售额处于不同水平时，「经营杠杆系数」可能不同。

collocations: calculate the degree of operating leverage
a high degree of operating leverage

words.enDefinition: how effectively a business uses capital to generate operating results

examples.en: The case compared capital efficiency at two factories with similar output but different equipment investments.
examples.zh: 案例比较了两家产量相近、设备投入不同的工厂的「资本使用效率」。

examples.en: Our report examined capital efficiency before and after the fictional retailer closed an unused warehouse.
examples.zh: 报告考察了虚构零售商关闭闲置仓库前后的「资本使用效率」。

words.enDefinition: a measure of cash generation relative to cash interest payments

examples.en: The worksheet measured cash interest coverage using cash generated before cash interest and tax payments.
examples.zh: 练习表用支付现金利息和税款前产生的现金衡量「现金利息保障倍数」。

examples.en: We compared cash interest coverage with the result based on reported operating profit in the case.
examples.zh: 我们将「现金利息保障倍数」与案例中按报告营业利润算出的结果作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a ratio comparing available earnings or cash flow with fixed commitments

examples.en: The sample calculation included lease payments alongside interest in its fixed charge coverage ratio.
examples.zh: 样本计算「固定费用保障倍数」时同时计入了租赁付款和利息。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which fixed charges belonged in the denominator of the fixed charge coverage ratio.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪些固定费用应计入「固定费用保障倍数」的分母。

collocations: calculate the fixed charge coverage ratio
define the fixed charge coverage ratio

words.enDefinition: the ability to adapt funding and spending when conditions change

examples.en: The class discussed financial flexibility after the fictional retailer faced a sudden drop in sales.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商的销售额突然下降后，同学们讨论了它的「财务灵活性」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which unused sources of funds might give the example company more financial flexibility.
examples.zh: 导师问，哪些尚未动用的资金来源可能增强示例公司的「财务灵活性」。

words.enDefinition: cash and available funding above the amount needed for foreseeable obligations

examples.en: The sample report showed how much liquidity headroom remained after allowing for its scheduled bills.
examples.zh: 样本报告显示，在计入预计付款后还剩多少「流动性余量」。

examples.en: We compared liquidity headroom across two seasons because the fictional company's payment schedule changed.
examples.zh: 由于虚构公司的付款时间表会变化，我们比较了两个季节的「流动性余量」。

words.enDefinition: inventory days plus receivables days minus payables days

examples.en: The exercise showed a shorter cash conversion cycle after customers paid sooner in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中顾客更早付款后，练习表显示「现金转换周期」缩短了。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why paying suppliers later could shorten the cash conversion cycle.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么晚一些支付供应商款项可能缩短「现金转换周期」。

words.enDefinition: the time from acquiring inventory to collecting cash from sales

examples.en: The sample operating cycle began when the retailer acquired inventory and ended when customers paid.
examples.zh: 样本的「营业周期」从零售商取得存货开始，到顾客付款结束。

examples.en: The tutor compared the operating cycle of a fast-selling shop with that of a furniture maker.
examples.zh: 导师比较了销售速度快的商店与一家家具制造商的「营业周期」。

words.enDefinition: days liquid assets can cover average cash operating costs

examples.en: The defensive interval ratio showed how many days the sample could cover its usual cash expenses.
examples.zh: 「防御区间比率」显示样本企业能够负担多少天的日常现金支出。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which liquid assets were included when calculating the defensive interval ratio.
examples.zh: 导师问，计算「防御区间比率」时纳入了哪些流动性较强的资产。

collocations: a defensive interval ratio expressed in days

words.enDefinition: short-term operating assets less short-term operating liabilities under a stated definition

examples.en: The worksheet calculated operating working capital from inventory, trade receivables, and trade payables in the simplified case.
examples.zh: 在简化案例中，练习表根据存货、应收账款和应付账款计算「经营性营运资金」。

examples.en: We checked whether the sample analyst excluded cash and borrowing from operating working capital.
examples.zh: 我们核对了样本分析员是否将现金和借款排除在「经营性营运资金」之外。

collocations: a measure of operating working capital

words.enDefinition: cash and other immediately available holdings divided by current liabilities

examples.en: The sample company had a lower cash ratio after using some cash to buy inventory.
examples.zh: 样本公司用部分现金采购存货后，「现金比率」降低了。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which amounts counted as cash when calculating the fictional retailer's cash ratio.
examples.zh: 老师问，计算虚构零售商的「现金比率」时，哪些金额算作现金类资产。

words.enDefinition: the average amount customers owe during a measured period

examples.en: The class used an average receivables balance instead of the single year-end figure in the comparison.
examples.zh: 在比较中，同学们采用「平均应收账款余额」，没有只用年末数字。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how seasonal sales affected the average receivables balance in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师问，季节性销售如何影响样本的「平均应收账款余额」。

words.enDefinition: the average amount owed to suppliers during the measured period

examples.en: The sample worksheet estimated the average payables balance from two figures shown on the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 样本练习表用资产负债表上列出的两个数字来估算「平均应付账款余额」。

examples.en: We checked which supplier balances counted toward the average payables balance for the case.
examples.zh: 我们核对了哪些供应商余额计入案例的「平均应付账款余额」。

words.enDefinition: a change in a ratio caused by its reference amount

examples.en: The tutor explained the denominator effect when the ratio rose despite an unchanged profit figure.
examples.zh: 利润数字不变而比率上升时，导师解释了「分母效应」。

examples.en: Our exercise showed a denominator effect after the sample company disposed of a large asset.
examples.zh: 样本公司处置一项大额资产后，练习表显示了「分母效应」。

words.expression: cash flow to net income ratio
words.lemma: cash flow to net income ratio
words.zhGloss: 经营现金流与净利润之比
words.enDefinition: operating cash flow divided by net income for the same period
acceptedZhAnswers: 经营现金流与净利润之比
acceptedEnVariants: cash flow to net income ratio

examples.en: The classroom table compared the cash flow to net income ratio across two reporting years.
examples.zh: 课堂表格比较了两个报告年度的「经营现金流与净利润之比」。

examples.en: We checked both underlying amounts before interpreting the cash flow to net income ratio in the exercise.
examples.zh: 解读练习中的「经营现金流与净利润之比」前，我们先核对了两个原始金额。

collocations: calculate the cash flow to net income ratio
compare the cash flow to net income ratio across years
interpret a cash flow to net income ratio

words.enDefinition: cash flow from operations expressed as a percentage of revenue

examples.en: The worksheet divided operating cash flow by revenue to calculate the operating cash flow margin.
examples.zh: 练习表用经营现金流除以收入，计算「经营现金流利润率」。

examples.en: The tutor asked why operating cash flow margin and accounting profit margin could move in different directions.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么「经营现金流利润率」与会计利润率的变动方向可能不同。

collocations: a higher operating cash flow margin

words.enDefinition: after-tax operating profit divided by average net operating assets

examples.en: We compared return on net operating assets after separating the sample companies' operating and financing balances.
examples.zh: 我们将样本公司的经营性余额和融资性余额分开后，比较了「净经营资产收益率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how a smaller asset base affected the return on net operating assets.
examples.zh: 导师问，资产基数减少会怎样影响「净经营资产收益率」。

collocations: calculate return on net operating assets
compare return on net operating assets
a higher return on net operating assets

words.enDefinition: operating profit after an estimated tax charge on operating income

examples.en: The worksheet excluded financing costs when it estimated net operating profit after tax for the sample.
examples.zh: 练习表估算样本的「税后净营业利润」时，没有计入融资成本。

examples.en: The tutor showed how the assumed tax rate affected the calculation of net operating profit after tax.
examples.zh: 导师展示了假定税率如何影响「税后净营业利润」的计算。

collocations: calculate net operating profit after tax
estimate net operating profit after tax
use net operating profit after tax

words.enDefinition: the extent to which reported earnings reflect performance that can persist

examples.en: The case discussed earnings quality after profits rose without a similar increase in cash receipts.
examples.zh: 利润上升而收款未同步增加后，案例讨论了「盈利质量」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why earnings quality could differ between two companies reporting the same profit.
examples.zh: 导师问，两家公司报告相同利润时，「盈利质量」为什么可能不同。

words.enDefinition: how faithfully and usefully reports describe an entity's finances

examples.en: The class considered financial reporting quality when a fictional company changed the way it described costs.
examples.zh: 虚构公司改变了成本的描述方式，同学们结合这一变化讨论了「财务报告质量」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how clear and complete explanations could improve financial reporting quality in the case.
examples.zh: 导师问，清楚完整的解释如何提高案例中的「财务报告质量」。

words.enDefinition: earnings likely to continue under ordinary business conditions

examples.en: We discussed sustainable earnings after separating the gain from the retailer's one-time warehouse sale.
examples.zh: 我们单独列出零售商一次性出售仓库的收益后，讨论了「可持续盈利」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which parts of the year's profit could count as sustainable earnings.
examples.zh: 导师问，该年利润的哪些部分可算作「可持续盈利」。

words.enDefinition: the extent to which current earnings tend to persist in later periods

examples.en: The class compared earnings persistence for operating profit and gains from occasional property sales.
examples.zh: 同学们比较了营业利润和偶尔处置房产所获收益的「盈利持续性」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why three strong quarters alone might reveal little about earnings persistence.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么仅凭三个表现强劲的季度可能很难判断「盈利持续性」。

words.enDefinition: earnings adjusted to approximate results under ordinary conditions

examples.en: Our worksheet estimated normalised earnings after removing the assumed impact of a temporary closure.
examples.zh: 练习表剔除假定的临时停业影响后，估算了「常态化盈利」。

examples.en: The tutor asked which assumptions supported the normalised earnings figure in the sample analysis.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本分析中「常态化盈利」的数字基于哪些假设。

words.enDefinition: the earnings figure shown in the published statements

examples.en: The group compared reported earnings with a separate measure used in the fictional company's presentation.
examples.zh: 小组将「列报盈利」与虚构公司展示材料中的另一项指标作了比较。

examples.en: We checked whether the headline amount matched reported earnings in the sample income statement.
examples.zh: 我们核对了标题金额是否与样本利润表中的「列报盈利」一致。

words.zhGloss: 按当前水平推算的盈利
words.enDefinition: earnings projected by extending a recent operating pace
acceptedZhAnswers: 按当前水平推算的盈利

examples.en: The tutor discussed why run-rate earnings based on a busy holiday month might be misleading.
examples.zh: 导师讨论了为什么根据假日旺季某个月「按当前水平推算的盈利」可能造成误解。

examples.en: We distinguished run-rate earnings from actual results for the full year in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 在课堂案例中，我们区分了「按当前水平推算的盈利」和全年实际业绩。

collocations: compare run-rate earnings with reported profits

words.enDefinition: reported earnings supported by actual cash generation

examples.en: In the sample, rising operating cash flows supported earnings growth, suggesting cash-backed earnings.
examples.zh: 样本中的经营现金流增长支持了利润增长，显示盈利可能「有现金支撑」。

examples.en: The lecturer asked what other information was needed before calling the result cash-backed earnings.
examples.zh: 讲师问，还需要哪些信息才能把这个结果称为「有现金支撑的盈利」。

words.enDefinition: the usefulness of reported cash flows for assessing recurring cash generation

examples.en: The case examined cash flow quality after a large payment arrived unusually early that quarter.
examples.zh: 一笔大额款项在该季度异常提前到账，案例以此考察「现金流质量」。

examples.en: Our group compared cash flow quality after accounting for the effect of the fictional asset sale.
examples.zh: 小组在考虑虚构资产出售的影响后，对「现金流质量」作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the difference between reported earnings and operating cash flow

examples.en: The earnings-to-cash gap widened when customer balances rose faster than collections in the sample.
examples.zh: 样本中客户欠款余额增长得比收款快，「盈利与现金流差额」扩大了。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether slower collections could explain the earnings-to-cash gap in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，示例中收款变慢能否解释「盈利与现金流差额」。

words.enDefinition: exposure to losses or revenue disruption because a large share of business depends on relatively few customers

examples.en: We checked customer concentration risk after discovering that one distributor accounted for most of the company's revenue.
examples.zh: 发现公司大部分收入来自一家经销商后，我们查看了「客户集中风险」。

examples.en: The note discussed customer concentration risk and disclosed the share of sales to the largest customer.
examples.zh: 附注讨论了「客户集中风险」，并披露了对最大客户的销售占比。

words.enDefinition: the portion of earnings attributable to accruals rather than cash flow

examples.en: The worksheet estimated the accrual component of profit using the two reported figures provided.
examples.zh: 练习表根据提供的两个报告数字估算盈利的「应计部分」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the accrual component might reverse in the next period in the example.
examples.zh: 导师问，示例中的「应计部分」是否可能在下一期转回。

collocations: compare the accrual component across periods

words.enDefinition: the portion of earnings reflected in cash flow

examples.en: The exercise separated the cash component of profit from the portion driven by accruals.
examples.zh: 练习把盈利的「现金流部分」和由应计项目形成的部分分开。

examples.en: We compared the cash component across two years after checking which cash measure the worksheet used.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习表采用的现金指标，再比较两年的「现金流部分」。

collocations: estimate the cash component of earnings
compare the cash component across years

words.enDefinition: accruals scaled by a stated measure such as average assets

examples.en: The accrual ratio in the exercise expressed total accruals as a share of average assets.
examples.zh: 练习中的「应计比率」用应计项目总额占平均资产的比例表示。

examples.en: We checked the formula in the footnote before comparing the accrual ratio across two fictional businesses.
examples.zh: 我们先核对脚注中的公式，再比较两家虚构企业的「应计比率」。

collocations: the denominator of an accrual ratio

words.enDefinition: estimated accruals attributable to choices by management rather than normal business activity

examples.en: The class discussed whether a statistical model could distinguish discretionary accruals from ordinary operating changes.
examples.zh: 同学们讨论统计模型能不能将「酌量性应计项目」与正常经营变化区分开。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why estimated discretionary accruals did not establish intent in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么估算出的「酌量性应计项目」无法确定虚构案例中的主观意图。

words.enDefinition: how closely accruals reflect or predict associated cash flows

examples.en: The tutor compared accrual quality for businesses with very different patterns of cash collection.
examples.zh: 导师比较了收款规律差异很大的企业的「应计项目质量」。

examples.en: We examined accrual quality after the sample's estimated collections moved further from actual cash receipts.
examples.zh: 样本估计收款与实际现金到账额的差距扩大后，我们研究了其「应计项目质量」。

words.enDefinition: when actual cash receipts or payments take place

examples.en: The case traced cash flow timing to explain why two months showed similar sales but different collections.
examples.zh: 案例追踪「现金流发生时点」，解释为什么两个月销售额相近而收款额不同。

examples.en: We distinguished cash flow timing from the overall amount collected during the full classroom period.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「现金流发生时点」与课堂所讨论整个期间的收款总额。

collocations: a change in cash flow timing

words.enDefinition: the delay between recording a sale and receiving the cash

examples.en: The sample report showed a longer cash collection lag after customers received extended payment terms.
examples.zh: 客户获得更长付款期后，样本报告显示「现金回收时滞」拉长了。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the cash collection lag explained differences between revenue and receipts.
examples.zh: 导师问，「现金回收时滞」可以怎样解释收入和收款的差异。

words.enDefinition: an increase in funds tied up in operating working capital

examples.en: The fictional shop's working capital build reflected its purchases before the annual student market.
examples.zh: 虚构商店在年度学生集市前备货，带来了「营运资金占用增加」。

examples.en: The cash bridge showed a working capital build even though the business reported higher profit.
examples.zh: 尽管企业报告的利润提高了，现金桥接表仍显示「营运资金占用增加」。

collocations: cash absorbed by a working capital build

words.enDefinition: the share of receivables outstanding for which the contractual payment date has already passed

examples.en: The past-due receivables ratio rose while total customer balances stayed almost unchanged during the second quarter.
examples.zh: 第二季度，顾客欠款总额几乎没有变化，但「逾期应收账款占比」上升了。

examples.en: We calculated the past-due receivables ratio using the balances in the agency's monthly ageing schedule.
examples.zh: 我们根据该机构月度账龄表中的余额计算了「逾期应收账款占比」。

words.enDefinition: the possibility that inventory will lose value because it becomes outdated or no longer marketable

examples.en: The tutor linked inventory obsolescence risk to older accessories that no longer fitted the latest devices.
examples.zh: 导师以不再适配新设备的老款配件解释「存货过时风险」。

examples.en: We assessed inventory obsolescence risk by reviewing stock ageing and comparing recent sales across the product range.
examples.zh: 我们查看库存账龄并比较各产品近期销售情况，评估「存货过时风险」。

words.enDefinition: to defer paying suppliers, which can temporarily preserve cash at the expense of slower settlement

examples.en: Some companies stretch supplier payments when they face a temporary shortage of cash for everyday operations.
examples.zh: 有些公司日常经营现金暂时不足时，会「拉长供应商付款周期」。

examples.en: The analyst asked whether the company could stretch supplier payments again without losing early payment discounts.
examples.zh: 分析员问，这家公司能否再次「拉长供应商付款周期」而不失去提前付款折扣。

collocations: stretch supplier payments during a cash shortage

words.enDefinition: the amount of cash taken up by an activity or balance increase

examples.en: The exercise attributed cash absorption to the retailer's larger stock position at the end of term.
examples.zh: 练习将「现金占用」归因于零售商学期末存货增加。

examples.en: We calculated cash absorption from changes in the operating balances shown in the sample table.
examples.zh: 我们根据样本表中经营性余额的变化计算了「现金占用」。

collocations: a temporary rise in cash absorption

words.enDefinition: a cash movement unlikely to repeat under ordinary conditions

examples.en: The tutor identified a non-recurring cash flow after the sample company sold its old premises.
examples.zh: 样本公司出售原经营场地后，导师识别出了一笔「非经常性现金流」。

examples.en: Our group separated the non-recurring cash flow before comparing the business's usual cash generation.
examples.zh: 小组先将「非经常性现金流」单列，再比较企业日常产生现金的情况。

words.enDefinition: the use of discretion to influence reported earnings

examples.en: The class discussed earnings management after comparing unexplained changes in the fictional company's estimates.
examples.zh: 同学们比较虚构公司未加解释的估计变更后，讨论了「盈余管理」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why unusual figures could prompt questions about earnings management without proving it occurred.
examples.zh: 导师解释，为什么异常数字会引发「盈余管理」方面的疑问，却无法证明它确实发生。

words.enDefinition: reporting practices that make earnings appear less variable over time

examples.en: The class debated whether the sample's unusually steady profits indicated income smoothing or stable operations.
examples.zh: 同学们讨论样本异常平稳的利润是反映「利润平滑」，还是说明经营稳定。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what additional evidence might help assess suspected income smoothing in the case.
examples.zh: 导师问，还需要什么证据来评估案例中疑似「利润平滑」的情形。

words.enDefinition: recognising unusually large charges in one period to improve the appearance of later results

examples.en: The case discussion considered big bath accounting after several unusually large charges appeared together.
examples.zh: 案例讨论涉及「大洗澡式会计处理」，当时有几笔异常大的支出同时列报。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished suspected big bath accounting from a single period of genuine deterioration.
examples.zh: 导师区分了疑似「大洗澡式会计处理」和某一期经营状况的实际恶化。

words.enDefinition: excess reserves later released to make earnings look better

examples.en: The class discussed cookie jar reserves after the fictional report showed unusually large reversals.
examples.zh: 虚构报告显示异常大额的转回后，同学们讨论了「用于调节盈利的储备」。

examples.en: Our tutor noted that a steady profit series alone did not establish cookie jar reserves.
examples.zh: 导师指出，仅有平稳的利润数据不足以确认存在「用于调节盈利的储备」。

collocations: the release of cookie jar reserves

words.enDefinition: room to exercise judgement within permitted accounting choices

examples.en: The tutor discussed accounting discretion when two fictional businesses made different assumptions about useful lives.
examples.zh: 两家虚构企业对使用寿命作出不同假设时，导师讨论了「会计判断裁量权」。

examples.en: We asked how accounting discretion affected comparability between the sample company and its industry peers.
examples.zh: 我们问，「会计判断裁量权」会如何影响样本公司与同行的可比性。

collocations: compare the use of accounting discretion

words.enDefinition: a difference between reported earnings and what analysts had expected

examples.en: The sample called it an earnings surprise because reported profit differed from the analysts' forecast.
examples.zh: 样本将这一差距称为「盈利预期偏差」，因为列报利润与分析师预测不同。

examples.en: Our exercise separated the earnings surprise from the year-over-year movement in the company's reported profits.
examples.zh: 练习区分了「盈利预期偏差」和公司所报告利润的同比变动。

words.enDefinition: the likelihood that a business can keep generating its cash flows

examples.en: We discussed cash flow sustainability after excluding proceeds from the fictional company's property sale.
examples.zh: 剔除虚构公司出售房产的所得后，我们讨论了「现金流可持续性」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which recurring activities mattered most for cash flow sustainability in the sample.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本中的哪些经常性活动对「现金流可持续性」最重要。

words.enDefinition: the durability and reliability of reported revenue sources

examples.en: The class discussed revenue quality after discovering that most growth came from a single temporary contract.
examples.zh: 发现大部分增长来自一份临时合同后，同学们讨论了「收入质量」。

examples.en: Our report linked revenue quality to repeat demand and actual collections in the fictional case.
examples.zh: 报告把「收入质量」与虚构案例中的重复需求和实际收款联系起来。

words.zhGloss: 非公认会计准则财务指标
words.enDefinition: a US financial measure differing from the corresponding GAAP measure in specified ways
acceptedZhAnswers: 非公认会计准则财务指标

examples.en: The sample earnings release presented a non-GAAP financial measure beside the closest figure calculated under GAAP.
examples.zh: 样本业绩公告把「非公认会计准则财务指标」列在按公认会计准则计算的最接近数字旁。

examples.en: Our tutor asked which adjustments separated the non-GAAP financial measure from the reported GAAP result.
examples.zh: 导师问，「非公认会计准则财务指标」与列报的公认会计准则结果之间有哪些调整。

collocations: a non-GAAP financial measure in an earnings release

words.enDefinition: a financial measure outside those defined by the applicable reporting framework

examples.en: The European sample report described why management used an alternative performance measure in its commentary.
examples.zh: 欧洲样本报告在管理层评论中解释了管理层使用「替代性业绩指标」的原因。

examples.en: We checked how the alternative performance measure had been calculated before comparing the fictional companies.
examples.zh: 比较虚构公司之前，我们核对了「替代性业绩指标」是怎么计算的。

words.zhGloss: 管理层定义的业绩指标
words.enDefinition: under IFRS 18, an income-and-expense subtotal used in public communications to convey management's view of company-wide performance, excluding subtotals specified by IFRS
acceptedZhAnswers: 管理层定义的业绩指标

examples.en: The sample IFRS note reconciled a management-defined performance measure to the closest specified profit subtotal.
examples.zh: 样本 IFRS 附注将「管理层定义的业绩指标」调节至最接近的规定利润小计。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the company used its management-defined performance measure in public communications.
examples.zh: 导师问，公司为什么在公开沟通材料中使用「管理层定义的业绩指标」。

collocations: a reconciliation of a management-defined performance measure

words.zhGloss: 最直接可比的准则指标
words.enDefinition: the closest GAAP measure to which a US non-GAAP measure is compared
acceptedZhAnswers: 最直接可比的准则指标
acceptedEnVariants: most directly comparable GAAP financial measure

examples.en: The sample reconciliation started with the most directly comparable GAAP measure from the income statement.
examples.zh: 样本调节表从利润表中的「最直接可比的准则指标」开始。

examples.en: We checked whether the sample chose operating profit as the most directly comparable GAAP measure.
examples.zh: 我们核对了样本是否把营业利润选为「最直接可比的准则指标」。

collocations: identify the most directly comparable GAAP measure
reconcile to the most directly comparable GAAP measure
present the most directly comparable GAAP measure

words.enDefinition: the specified subtotal closest to an alternative measure being reconciled

examples.en: The IFRS example used operating profit as the most directly comparable subtotal for the adjusted measure.
examples.zh: IFRS 示例以营业利润作为调整后指标的「最直接可比的小计」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to find the most directly comparable subtotal in the sample reconciliation.
examples.zh: 导师让我们在样本调节表中找出「最直接可比的小计」。

collocations: identify the most directly comparable subtotal
reconcile to the most directly comparable subtotal
present the most directly comparable subtotal

words.enDefinition: an amount listed to explain part of a difference between measures

examples.en: The sample table labelled each reconciling item before showing the adjusted total on the last line.
examples.zh: 样本表格先为各个「调节项目」加上标签，再在最后一行列出调整后总额。

examples.en: We checked whether the largest reconciling item also appeared in the notes to the published accounts.
examples.zh: 我们核对了金额最大的「调节项目」是否也出现在已发布报表的附注中。

collocations: the tax effect of a reconciling item

words.enDefinition: a table connecting two amounts by listing the intervening differences

examples.en: The reconciliation table listed each adjustment between the reported and adjusted figures in the sample.
examples.zh: 「指标调节表」列出了样本列报数据和调整后数据之间的每项调整。

examples.en: Our group checked whether the reconciliation table added up to the total in the presentation.
examples.zh: 小组核对了「指标调节表」的合计是否等于展示材料中的总额。

words.zhGloss: 准则与非准则指标调节
words.enDefinition: a breakdown connecting a GAAP measure to a non-GAAP figure
acceptedZhAnswers: 准则与非准则指标调节

examples.en: The exercise used a GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation to check how adjusted profit related to reported profit.
examples.zh: 练习用「准则与非准则指标调节」核对调整后利润与列报利润的关系。

examples.en: We compared the GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation for the two years disclosed in the fictional release.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构公告所披露的两个年度的「准则与非准则指标调节」。

words.enDefinition: an explanation of what a measure includes and represents

examples.en: We read the measure definition before comparing adjusted profit across the two sample reports.
examples.zh: 我们先读了「指标定义」，再比较两份样本报告里的调整后利润。

examples.en: The fictional report put the measure definition beneath the table showing three years of results.
examples.zh: 虚构报告把「指标定义」放在三年业绩表的下方。

collocations: a change to the measure definition

words.enDefinition: a revision to what a reported measure includes or means

examples.en: The note explained a change in definition before it presented the adjusted results for both years.
examples.zh: 附注先解释了「指标定义变更」，再列示两年的调整后结果。

examples.en: We checked whether the change in definition made the earlier numbers unsuitable for direct comparison.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「指标定义变更」是否使早期数字不宜直接比较。

words.enDefinition: the method and conventions used to obtain a stated amount

examples.en: The sample disclosed the basis of calculation for both the operating margin and adjusted earnings.
examples.zh: 样本披露了营业利润率和调整后盈利的「计算口径」。

examples.en: We compared the basis of calculation in the footnotes before aligning the two companies' ratios.
examples.zh: 我们先比较了脚注里的「计算口径」，再统一两家公司的比率口径。

words.enDefinition: a reporting section explaining performance and financial condition from management's perspective

examples.en: The sample US filing used management discussion and analysis to explain the change in operating results.
examples.zh: 样本美国申报文件通过「管理层讨论与分析」解释了经营业绩的变化。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the management discussion and analysis revealed about the company's slow collections.
examples.zh: 导师问，「管理层讨论与分析」透露了哪些关于公司收款缓慢的信息。

collocations: a management discussion and analysis section

words.enDefinition: a public announcement summarising an entity's financial results

examples.en: The fictional retailer's earnings release listed comparable sales alongside the change in reported revenue.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商的「业绩公告」并列列出了可比销售额和报告收入口径的变动。

examples.en: Our group checked whether the earnings release used the same definition as the annual report.
examples.zh: 小组核对「业绩公告」使用的定义与年报是否相同。

words.enDefinition: slides used to explain financial results to an audience

examples.en: The earnings presentation showed which categories accounted for the change in the fictional chain's costs.
examples.zh: 「业绩发布演示材料」显示哪些类别解释了虚构连锁企业成本的变动。

examples.en: We checked whether the earnings presentation used the same adjustments as the written release.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「业绩发布演示材料」的调整是否和书面公告相同。

words.enDefinition: management's explanation of why it used a measure or choice

examples.en: The report gave management's rationale for showing adjusted operating profit beside the statutory subtotal.
examples.zh: 报告给出了「管理层说明的理由」，解释为何在法定小计旁列出调整后营业利润。

examples.en: We compared management's rationale with the adjustment figures listed below it in the sample report.
examples.zh: 我们把「管理层说明的理由」与样本报告在其下方列出的调整数字作了比较。

words.enDefinition: operating profit after specified adjustments in a supplementary measure

examples.en: The sample reconciled adjusted operating profit to the amount shown in its main income statement.
examples.zh: 样本将「调整后营业利润」调节至利润表主表中的金额。

examples.en: We examined whether the same costs were excluded from adjusted operating profit in both years.
examples.zh: 我们检查两年计算「调整后营业利润」时剔除的成本是否相同。

words.enDefinition: net income modified by stated adjustments for analysis or disclosure

examples.en: The fictional company's adjusted net income reflected a stated tax effect for each excluded charge.
examples.zh: 虚构公司的「调整后净利润」反映了各项剔除费用的税务影响。

examples.en: We checked whether adjusted net income and reported earnings moved in the same direction.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「调整后净利润」和列报盈利的变动方向是否相同。

collocations: a reconciliation of adjusted net income

words.enDefinition: a reported per-share result using earnings that include stated adjustments

examples.en: The sample table listed adjusted earnings per share beside the reported figure for the same year.
examples.zh: 样本表在同一年的列报数据旁列出了「调整后每股收益」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the share count used for adjusted earnings per share had also changed.
examples.zh: 导师问，计算「调整后每股收益」所用的股数是否也发生了变动。

collocations: a reconciliation of adjusted earnings per share

words.zhGloss: 调整后息税折旧摊销前利润
words.enDefinition: EBITDA modified by additional adjustments specified by its presenter
acceptedZhAnswers: 调整后息税折旧摊销前利润

examples.en: The sample release stated exactly which items management excluded when calculating adjusted EBITDA.
examples.zh: 样本公告明确列出了管理层在计算「调整后息税折旧摊销前利润」时剔除的项目。

examples.en: We read the definition of adjusted EBITDA before comparing it with the previous year's figure.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读了「调整后息税折旧摊销前利润」的定义，再与上年数字作比较。

words.enDefinition: an operating profit margin calculated using stated adjustments

examples.en: The exercise divided adjusted operating profit by the stated revenue to find the adjusted operating margin.
examples.zh: 练习用调整后营业利润除以列示收入，得出「调整后营业利润率」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the adjusted operating margin changed less than the reported margin in the table.
examples.zh: 导师问，为什么表里「调整后营业利润率」的变动小于报告利润率。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which an adjustment changes the associated tax figure

examples.en: The sample note explained the tax effect of an adjustment linked to an unusually large charge.
examples.zh: 样本附注解释了一笔与异常大额费用有关的「调整的所得税影响」。

examples.en: We checked whether the tax effect of an adjustment was listed separately in the reconciliation.
examples.zh: 我们核对了调节表中是否单独列出「调整的所得税影响」。

collocations: calculate the tax effect of an adjustment
disclose the tax effect of an adjustment
estimate the tax effect of an adjustment

words.enDefinition: an adjustment calculated after allowing for its tax effect

examples.en: The sample table reported an after-tax adjustment before arriving at the fictional company's adjusted net income.
examples.zh: 样本表在算出虚构公司的调整后净利润之前，列出了一个「税后调整额」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the after-tax adjustment differed from the amount shown before tax.
examples.zh: 导师问，「税后调整额」与税前列示的金额有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: the part of an adjustment affecting the share attributable to non-controlling owners

examples.en: The IFRS example showed the effect on non-controlling interests in a separate column for each adjustment.
examples.zh: IFRS 示例为每项调整单独列示了「对非控股权益的影响」。

examples.en: We checked whether the effect on non-controlling interests changed the amount attributable to the parent company.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「对非控股权益的影响」是否改变了归属于母公司的金额。

collocations: calculate the effect on non-controlling interests
disclose the effect on non-controlling interests
a column for the effect on non-controlling interests

words.enDefinition: an income or expense item not expected to arise regularly

examples.en: The example treated the gain from selling an old warehouse as a non-recurring item.
examples.zh: 示例把出售旧仓库的收益视为「非经常性项目」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked whether an item described as a non-recurring item had appeared in earlier reports.
examples.zh: 导师核对了被称为「非经常性项目」的事项是否也出现在更早的报告里。

collocations: an adjustment for a non-recurring item

words.enDefinition: an item categorised outside operating results under a stated basis

examples.en: The worksheet treated interest income as a non-operating item for the sample manufacturing company.
examples.zh: 对这家样本制造商，练习表把利息收入视为「非经营性项目」。

examples.en: We checked the notes before treating the same transaction as a non-operating item in both samples.
examples.zh: 在两个样本中都把同一交易视为「非经营性项目」之前，我们先核对了附注。

words.enDefinition: an expense associated with reorganising part of an entity

examples.en: The sample showed a restructuring charge after the fictional retailer announced plans to combine two branches.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商宣布计划合并两家分店后，样本列出一笔「重组费用」。

examples.en: We checked whether another restructuring charge appeared in the report for the preceding year.
examples.zh: 我们核对了上一年的报告是否也出现另一笔「重组费用」。

collocations: a restructuring charge in operating expenses

words.enDefinition: expenses incurred in connection with acquiring another business

examples.en: The sample listed acquisition-related costs for advisers and due diligence in its adjustment table.
examples.zh: 样本在调整表中列出了顾问和尽职调查产生的「收购相关费用」。

examples.en: Our group checked which acquisition-related costs the fictional company had excluded from its adjusted figure.
examples.zh: 小组核对了虚构公司在调整后指标中剔除了哪些「收购相关费用」。

words.enDefinition: expenses of combining operations after a business acquisition

examples.en: The case included integration costs for bringing the two companies onto the same ordering system.
examples.zh: 案例列出了把两家公司合并到同一订购系统所产生的「并购整合费用」。

examples.en: We compared integration costs over two years to see how much the adjustment had changed.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两年的「并购整合费用」，看这项调整变动了多少。

words.enDefinition: an agreement by which parties resolve a lawsuit

examples.en: The sample report explained that a litigation settlement affected the fictional company's annual expenses.
examples.zh: 样本报告解释，一项「诉讼和解」影响了虚构公司的年度费用。

examples.en: Our group checked where the litigation settlement appeared in the reconciliation of adjusted net income.
examples.zh: 我们小组核对了「诉讼和解」出现在调整后净利润调节表的哪里。

collocations: costs associated with a litigation settlement

words.enDefinition: an amount recovered from an insurer for an insured loss

examples.en: The fictional retailer received an insurance recovery after stock was damaged in its warehouse.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商的仓库存货受损后，收到一笔「保险赔款收入」。

examples.en: We checked whether the insurance recovery had been excluded from the adjusted result in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习中的调整后结果是否剔除了「保险赔款收入」。

collocations: account for an insurance recovery in a reconciliation

words.enDefinition: an amount added back to a measure in an adjustment

examples.en: The classroom reconciliation included an add-back for an expense excluded from the adjusted profit measure.
examples.zh: 课堂调节表把从调整后利润指标中剔除的一项费用作为「加回项」。

examples.en: We checked which original charge the add-back in the table was meant to reverse.
examples.zh: 我们核对了表里的「加回项」是为了抵销哪笔原始费用。

collocations: an expense listed as an add-back

words.enDefinition: the stated rules for omitting items from a measure

examples.en: The tutor asked whether the stated exclusion criteria had been applied consistently to both years.
examples.zh: 导师问，报告列明的「剔除标准」是否在两个年度得到一致应用。

examples.en: We read the exclusion criteria before checking which entries remained in the sample adjusted profit.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「剔除标准」，再检查样本调整后利润保留了哪些项目。

words.enDefinition: applying the same principle to comparable gains and losses

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the sample's symmetrical treatment applied to comparable gains as well as charges.
examples.zh: 导师问，样本的「对称处理」是否同时适用于可比的收益和费用。

examples.en: The exercise used symmetrical treatment when adjusting both gains and losses from similar disposals.
examples.zh: 练习调整类似处置产生的收益和损失时采用了「对称处理」。

collocations: symmetrical treatment of gains and losses

words.enDefinition: an accompanying explanation of how values were reconciled

examples.en: The reconciliation note explained why one figure in the original report had been grouped differently.
examples.zh: 「指标调节说明」解释了原报告中的一项数字为什么采用不同分组。

examples.en: We checked the reconciliation note for explanations of the adjustments listed in the accompanying table.
examples.zh: 我们查看「指标调节说明」，找出它对附表中各项调整的解释。

collocations: a reconciliation note explaining the differences
